description: 2024 NCFO Terminals File is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by USDOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. This is information about ferry terminals that are included in the 2024 NCFO dataset. New for this year, the terminals file is presented as a single entry per terminal. In the case where multiple operators use a terminal and their answers disagree, the answers have been combined. see Methodology for information. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 18 columns, among them term_state, in_operation, terminal_id, parking, latitude, census_year. The portal shows 2026-06-10 as the last data update. Attribution given: USDOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
